pr_title: Fix slider sample playing before the slider begins
pr_body:
Fixes an issue introduced by #25748 whereby the sliding sample sound can be played before the slider begins.

Closes #25870.
pr_comments: This PR was rushed, somebody can probably make it cleaner

issue_context.title: Slider slide sound can be heard early even if hitting other objects stacked on top (after fix of #25748)
issue_context.body:
### Type

Game behaviour

### Bug description

A slider's slide sound can be heard even if hitting objects that are stacked on top of the area of the slider instead of the slider itself. This only happens for as long as either key is held down.

### Screenshots or videos


https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/77366515/ccfb9c0f-4f28-4e09-88d4-1028d6fd894a
